# `mise dotfiles history show`

- **用法：** `mise dotfiles history show [FLAGS] [REF]`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/dotfiles/history/show.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/history/show.rs)

Show a checkpoint: its trigger, changes, and operation journal

Prints the checkpoint's trigger, description, time, and machine, the files that changed since the previous checkpoint, and the tracked entries it covers. For a checkpoint that an operation recorded, also prints the operation's journal of the files it wrote.

## 参数
- **`[REF]`** — 数字检查点 ID、`latest`（默认值）、`latest~N` 或 `commit:<sha>`

## 标志
- **`-J --json`** — 以 JSON 格式输出
- **`--files`** — 列出快照中的每个文件
- **`--path <PATH>`** — 在此路径发生更改的检查点中解析 `latest~N`
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## Examples

Show the newest checkpoint

```
mise dot history show
```

List every file in an older checkpoint

```
mise dot history show latest~2 --files
```
